notes.title: To celebrate the launch of Super Drift Blade, all my works are discounted.
notes.content:
Dear players:

[b]My new game, "Super Drift Blade," is now online! Come support us! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2847740/
[h1]Quick Start Guide for "Super Drift Blade"! [/h1]

[list]
[*]This game is quite complex, not a simple roguelike.
[*]We recommend playing in windowed mode. Switching screens may cause icon errors; if you encounter this, please restart the game. (This is a GameMaker bug that I haven't fixed yet.)
[*]If you think it's good, please leave a review on Steam. Your review means a lot to me! Thank you, boss!
[*]I'm not being sympathetic, nor am I being sympathetic. Just being able to make a game, get it made, have people play it, and sell it is a huge win! I'm just worried I won't connect with the players (again, play the demo first).
[*] Remember to claim your free OST.
[/list]

[h1]Meanwhile, all my other games are on sale! [/h1]

notes.title: New game about OCD "Balance 100" will be available on the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello, everyone:


I recently wanted to introduce you to my new work "Balance 100", the demo will be available on June 19 during the Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219190/

[h1][b]Game Description[/b][/h1]

This is a precise placement game that requires both hands to operate. The game will be available on Steam on July 17.

[previewyoutube=b5KV1fde7BA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]About the Steam Next Fest[/b][/h1]

The game will be released in the recent New Products Festival demo, so that you players to go free experience, while the new festival demo will be than the prologue to provide another two new small mode.
[olist]
[*] Endless mode, players can be in the endless mode, and constantly have to generate the cat into its litter, to reach the ultimate boredom!
[*] Electromagnetic Maze, where players need to help ghost cats dodge obstacles and finally ascend safely to the sky to feel the ultimate heartbeat!
[/olist]

[previewyoutube=l2gAS7bXSFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Finally[/b][/h1]
I am completely self-researching and self-publishing this "Balance 100", so the release publicity is limited, so I hope you will help and promote it.
Please Wishlist Balance 100, and give me the Triforce to develop more interesting and very new Gameplay triangle, I am also very willing to explore more possibilities of game development with you players.


See you soon!


LiuJiajun
June 13, 2023

notes.title: Bubble People has already been downloaded by over 100,000, thank you all.
notes.content:
Hello, friends.

The Bubble Man" has exceeded 100,000 downloads so far.

[b]It's a surprise beyond expectation, and I accept it with a stable emotion. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41000760/9d83fe6d21c78b4239526feb6111c7a484d67980.png[/img]

It has nothing to do with whether the evaluation is good or bad, but first of all, thank you very much for your willingness to try this little experimental game of mine. If I can make you feel a little bit more interesting, that's even better. Regardless of the original intention and the content of the game, it is good to gather so many people to share this game, exchange different opinions and share their stories.

[b]Everyone's story is the best story, similar is empathy, different is each wonderful. [/b]


Finally, thank you for the concern of some friends, do not worry, I'm a happy man ːsteamhappyː
I also wish you all good health and happiness.


By the way, my other work "[b]Treasure Drifter: Nian[/b]" will be released on October 29, looking forward to your play. thank you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235450/Treasure_Drifter_Nian/


Liujiajun
